acceptance_rule: Pass if aggregate EV and sleeve PnL improve, EV and PnL improve in all three windows, max drawdown worsens by no more than 0.5 percentage points in any window, the sleeve keeps at least 40 closed trades, and the clean earnings 8-K bucket has at least 10 closed trades.
hypothesis: Inside the accepted SEC financial-report T+1 paper sleeve, clean earnings 8-K filings with Item 2.02 and no auxiliary items beyond 9.01 may deserve different paper risk than noisier earnings 8-Ks because the semantic event is more directly tied to results.
